issues.subtopic_definition: Account hacked, stolen, disabled, banned or locked; unauthorised account changes
issues.name: Account hacked, locked, or unexpectedly altered
issues.description: Users report their account being taken over, username or settings changed, playlists missing, or being forced to repeatedly change passwords.

issues.subtopic_definition: Cannot log in or stay logged in; forced logouts; password reset fails
issues.name: Unable to log in or staying logged out
issues.description: Users cannot log in despite correct credentials, get logged out repeatedly, or receive errors when trying to sign back in.

issues.subtopic_definition: Other access/account issue not covered above (code-side default when the model returns an unlisted access subtopic)
issues.name: Miscellaneous access complaints and ad frustrations
issues.description: Reviews mix general account-access remarks with complaints about advertising and app quality that do not describe a single access problem.
issues.note: Quotes mix access complaints with ad-related and general frustrations rather than one access problem.

issues.subtopic_definition: Signup, email/phone verification codes, linking Facebook/Google accounts
issues.name: Signup and verification codes failing
issues.description: New or returning users cannot complete signup, receive or use email or phone verification codes, or link social accounts.

issues.subtopic_definition: Unexpected, duplicate or post-cancellation charges, refunds, payment problems
issues.name: Unexpected charges and payment problems
issues.description: Users are charged after cancelling, face duplicate or unexplained deductions, or have payments that fail or do not reflect in their account.

issues.subtopic_definition: Premium-only controls: forced shuffle, skip limits, can't pick songs, features moved behind the paywall
issues.name: Free tier locked features behind premium
issues.description: Users feel basic controls such as skipping, replaying, choosing songs, and lyrics were moved behind the premium paywall.

issues.subtopic_definition: Other billing issue
issues.name: Miscellaneous billing and plan complaints
issues.description: Reviews cover varied billing matters such as student verification rejection, regional card issues, and bundle changes that do not share one clear problem.
issues.note: Quotes span student verification, regional payment, and bundle issues with no single shared problem.

issues.subtopic_definition: Paid premium not activating, premium benefits missing, plan/trial not applied, cancellation difficulty
issues.name: Premium purchase or benefits not applying
issues.description: Users cannot buy premium, paid premium does not activate or lacks its benefits, or they struggle to cancel or manage their plan.

issues.subtopic_definition: Price too high, price increases, value for money, student/family plan pricing
issues.name: Premium subscription seen as too expensive
issues.description: Users feel the subscription price is too high for the value received, especially compared with cheaper or free alternatives.

issues.subtopic_definition: Platform content decisions, artist bans, political or moral objections tied to content
issues.name: Objections to platform content and artist removals
issues.description: Users object to Spotify removing artists or songs, or to content decisions and advertisements tied to political or moral positions.

issues.subtopic_definition: Lyrics missing, paywalled or out of sync
issues.name: Lyrics fail to load or are missing
issues.description: Lyrics show a 'couldn't load' message or do not appear for many songs, including for premium subscribers.

issues.subtopic_definition: Songs, albums, artists or podcasts missing, greyed out, removed or region-locked
issues.name: Songs and albums unavailable or removed
issues.description: Tracks, albums, or artists appear greyed out, show as unavailable, disappear from libraries, or cannot be found in certain regions.

issues.subtopic_definition: Other catalog issue
issues.name: Miscellaneous catalog and library quirks
issues.description: Assorted complaints about playlists, song titles displayed in other languages, filtering, and unsaving content without a single shared cause.
issues.note: Quotes cover playlist preferences, language display, filters, and unsaving, which are unrelated problems.

issues.subtopic_definition: Podcast/audiobook content, video podcasts, unwanted podcast promotion
issues.name: Unwanted podcasts and audiobooks cluttering the app
issues.description: Users are flooded with podcast and audiobook promotions they do not want, or podcast episodes fail to appear or are unavailable in their region.

issues.subtopic_definition: Recommendations, algorithm, repetitive suggestions, Discover Weekly, autoplay/radio picks, shuffle repeating songs
issues.name: Recommendations replacing chosen songs
issues.description: Users find the app plays suggested or unrelated songs instead of the music they selected or in their chosen playlist and shuffle order.

issues.subtopic_definition: Search results, finding music, browse/discovery features
issues.name: Search returns wrong or unplayable results
issues.description: Searching for a specific song leads to unrelated playlists, does not play the song asked for, or makes finding music difficult.

issues.subtopic_definition: Cannot download, downloads stuck, offline mode not working
issues.name: Downloads fail or offline mode breaks
issues.description: Users cannot download music, downloads stall or reload repeatedly, or offline playback fails and logs them out.

issues.subtopic_definition: Downloaded/saved music or liked songs disappear or must be re-downloaded
issues.name: Downloaded songs vanish or must be re-downloaded
issues.description: Previously downloaded music and liked songs disappear after logouts or updates, forcing users to download content again.

issues.subtopic_definition: Other download/offline issue (storage location, SD card, limits)
issues.name: Download storage location and limit problems
issues.description: Users face issues with SD card storage, download caps, auto-download behaviour, and local files not appearing.

issues.subtopic_definition: General criticism or 'bad app' without a specific supported topic
issues.name: General dissatisfaction with the app
issues.description: Users express broad disappointment, calling the app bad or saying updates removed useful features, without naming a specific problem.

issues.subtopic_definition: General praise without a specific praised feature
issues.name: General praise and mixed opinions
issues.description: Reviews offer broad praise or mixed sentiment without pointing to a specific feature or complaint.

issues.subtopic_definition: Unrelated, meaningless, unsupported-language, or boycott-slogan text
issues.name: Unrelated or unclear review text
issues.description: Reviews contain off-topic remarks, incomplete phrases, or statements that do not describe a discernible product problem.

issues.subtopic_definition: Sound quality, volume levels, equalizer, audio glitches
issues.name: Poor sound quality and volume problems
issues.description: Users notice muddy audio, sudden volume changes, distorted sound, broken crossfade, or no sound while skipping tracks.

issues.subtopic_definition: 'No internet connection'/offline errors while online, failure to load or buffer
issues.name: False 'no internet connection' errors while online
issues.description: The app wrongly reports no internet connection or fails to load content even though the device is connected and streaming works elsewhere.

issues.subtopic_definition: App crashes, freezes, won't open, black screen
issues.name: App crashes, freezes, or fails to open playlists
issues.description: The app crashes, lags, freezes, or refuses to open playlists and songs, often requiring restarts to recover.

issues.subtopic_definition: Bluetooth, car, Android Auto, Chromecast, Connect, smart speakers, watches
issues.name: Device connection and control problems
issues.description: Playback fails to switch cleanly between phone, Bluetooth, car, or speakers, and the resumed track or controls behave unpredictably.

issues.subtopic_definition: Other playback issue
issues.name: Miscellaneous playback control glitches
issues.description: Reports include missing playback controls, widget or notification bugs, queue and session issues, and button misplacement without one common cause.
issues.note: Quotes cover notification controls, session creation, playlist adding, and button swaps, which are distinct issues.

issues.subtopic_definition: Slow, laggy, battery drain, data or storage usage, overheating
issues.name: Slow performance and battery or data drain
issues.description: The app is sluggish, takes long to load, drains battery in the background, or buffers excessively.

issues.subtopic_definition: Music stops, pauses, skips or jumps by itself; songs won't play
issues.name: Music stops, pauses, or skips unexpectedly
issues.description: Tracks cut out after seconds, pause on their own, skip to other songs, or refuse to play when selected.

issues.subtopic_definition: Support replies but does not solve the problem
issues.name: Support replies fail to resolve problems
issues.description: Users contact support and receive replies that do not fix the issue or leave the problem unresolved for weeks.

issues.subtopic_definition: Cannot contact support, no human, no reply
issues.name: No way to reach human support
issues.description: Users cannot find a phone line or live support channel and receive no reply to emails about billing or account problems.

issues.subtopic_definition: Too many, too long, too loud or repeated ads interrupting listening
issues.name: Too many and too long ads
issues.description: Users find ads play too often, run too long, are too loud, or are irrelevant, interrupting listening.

issues.subtopic_definition: Buttons, gestures, lockscreen/notification controls, widgets, sleep timer, settings
issues.name: Missing or changed playback controls
issues.description: Buttons such as loop, replay, rewind, skip, shuffle, and radio have been removed or moved, reducing control over playback.

issues.subtopic_definition: Managing playlists, library, liked songs, queue order, sorting, editing
issues.name: Queue and playlist management problems
issues.description: Users cannot add songs to the queue, sort or edit playlists, or play playlists in their intended order after updates.

issues.subtopic_definition: Other usability issue not covered above
issues.name: Miscellaneous usability annoyances
issues.description: Mixed complaints cover unwanted suggestions, bugs after updates, lyrics and ads, and general interface frustrations without one clear theme.
issues.note: Quotes span suggestion settings, ads, lyrics, and general bugs rather than a single usability problem.

issues.subtopic_definition: Layout, redesigns, home feed, finding things, confusing navigation, design changes
issues.name: Disliked layout and navigation redesigns
issues.description: Users find redesigned home screens, library layouts, and navigation harder to use after updates removed familiar features.
